name: Arcadia Public Library Teen Volunteering
what_you_do: Pick a job. You can help with computers, fix book shelves, work the front desk, teach adults tech, help at events or join the Teen Advisory Group.
who_can_apply: You must be 13 or older. Some jobs, like Smart Squad Tutor and Teen Advisory Group, are only for grades 9 to 12.
duration: Most jobs: 2 hours a week for at least 6 months. Some differ.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed as of Nov 3, 2026.
how_to_apply: Get a Volunteer Application at the library or on its page. You must turn it in yourself at the Account Services Desk.
notes: If chosen, you must do fingerprinting and a background check. The library sets it up at no cost. Summer Reading helpers (ages 13 to 18) work in June and July. Questions: (626) 821-5567.
